title: L1-F2: composed option/variant/table displays must not be classified as verbatim source-prose
description:
Repair independent-audit blocker L1-F2 (full evidence in the NOTES of eshyra-o9bd.16.1; read them first): field-provenance.json classifies compiler-COMPOSED display strings as `source-prose`, the only class a consumer may present as verbatim source authority (packages/core/src/rules/fieldProvenance.ts). ADR-0020 bars 2 and 7. Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md.

Affected (fix every occurrence of each shape, then sweep siblings): feature:draconic-bloodline:dragon-ancestor /choices/0/options/*/text ('Dragon: Black; Damage Type: Acid', built in deriveFeatureChoices.ts ~1812); feature:circle-of-the-land:circle-spells /choices/0/options/*/text; magic-item:elemental-gem, horn-of-valhalla, bag-of-tricks /variants/*/text (built in parseMagicItems.ts ~433, ~366, ~528); table:travel-pace /columns (expanded labels 'Distance per Minute' etc., parseTables.ts ~1273); table:food-drink-and-lodging and table:services /rows folded group+row labels (parseTables.ts ~904, ~922). Declarations: fieldProvenanceDeclarations.ts ~833-836 (feature option bodies), the named-entry magic-item variant declaration, ~1182-1196 (table columns/rows).

DESIGN (decided by the Captain): reclassify the constructed strings to `source-derived` (deterministically composed from pinned source cells: truthful and attributable but NOT verbatim), with reasons that say they are composed. Where a declaration covers both genuinely literal and composed strings under one pointer prefix, split it more specifically (the declaration granularity is per (kind, pointer prefix); use a narrower prefix or a per-record override mechanism if one already exists) so genuine verbatim passages KEEP source-prose. Do not demote real verbatim text to hide the problem, and do not change the displayed strings themselves. Sweep: find every other compiler code path that interpolates headers/labels/cells into a string emitted under a source-prose declaration (grep the producers for template literals and joins feeding text/label/rows/columns fields) and fix the same class; list the sweep and its result in the thaw note.

Regenerate the canonical pack with `npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/`; `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` must match. Permanent evidence: a generalized producer-to-classification check for constructed option/variant/table displays, keeping the concrete witnesses (SRD pp.22, 44, 74, 84, 220, 226) and a positive control that a genuine verbatim passage stays source-prose. Add thaw note docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/2026-11-01-eshyra-o9bd-16-7-2-composed-display-provenance.md. Do not weaken tests; do not touch freeze-manifest hashes or the freeze guard.
notes:
BLOCKED (no commit; bead left open). Declaration mechanism cannot express the required split without redesign.

Why: fieldProvenance.ts classifies by (kind, pointerPrefix) only; walkFieldPointers collapses every array index to '*' and no declaration keys on record key. The per-record override the spec allows does not exist (grep: no recordKey/override mechanism in fieldProvenance.ts, emit.ts, packLoader.ts). Narrower prefixes are not available because the composed and verbatim records share the identical pointer:
- feature /choices/*/options/*/text: composed 17 (dragon-ancestor 10, circle-of-the-land 7) vs 74 verbatim options under the same pointer (fighting-style, metamagic, invocations, pact-boon, hunter, defensive-tactics, ...).
- magic-item /variants/*/text (namedEntry): composed 11 (elemental-gem 4, horn-of-valhalla 4, bag-of-tricks 3) vs 30 verbatim (crystal-ball, figurine-of-wondrous-power, ioun-stone, ring-of-elemental-command).
- table /columns and /rows: composed only in table:travel-pace /columns and table:food-drink-and-lodging + table:services /rows (folded group+row labels) vs 107 other tables whose columns/rows are raw verbatim cells under the same pointers.
Reclassifying the shared pointer to source-derived would demote genuine verbatim text, which the spec forbids. Records.json cannot change to split the shapes (spec step 4).

Options for the dispatcher to decide (both need a design call, not an implementation guess):
(a) Extend the provenance mechanism with an optional record-key scope on declarations (e.g. recordKey or per-record override list), longest-match on (kind, recordKey, prefix), bump FIELD_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA, update packLoader/verify. Touches src/rules/fieldProvenance.ts, packLoader.ts, verifier, and fieldProvenanceDeclarations.ts.
(b) Change the importer output shape so composed displays sit under a distinct pointer (e.g. a displayText field under a source-derived declaration) and the verbatim text stays under the source-prose pointer. This changes records.json, so it is a deliberate regeneration decision, not this bead's scope under step 4.

Sweep: not completed because the primary split is blocked. Known producers to include in the sweep: deriveFeatureChoices.ts ~1812, parseMagicItems.ts ~366/~433/~528, parseTables.ts ~904/~922/~1273. No declarations were changed and no files were modified. Worktree is clean.
2026-11-01 Captain design decision (unblocks Haiku's blocker): option (a), record-scoped declarations. FieldProvenanceDeclaration gains optional recordKeys. The schema bumps to field-provenance-v2. classifyFieldPointer takes a required recordKey, and a matching scoped declaration beats any unscoped one. The importer gets a dead-scope gate. records.json must stay byte-identical. Option (b), moving composed text to new pointers, was rejected because it would change record shapes for every consumer.
COMPLETION (coordinator design: option (a), record-scoped declarations). Commit e24b380f on branch eshyra-o9bd.16.7.2 (not pushed).

Schema: FIELD_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA -> field-provenance-v2. Optional recordKeys on declarations. classifyFieldPointer takes a required recordKey; scoped beats unscoped, then longest prefix. buildFieldProvenanceManifest validates recordKeys and rejects overlapping scoped declarations. packLoader validates v2 and rejects v1.

Declarations changed (all unscoped source-prose kept for the verbatim majority):
- feature /choices/*/options/*/text, scoped to feature:draconic-bloodline:dragon-ancestor and feature:circle-of-the-land:circle-spells -> source-derived (composed from printed headers/cells, SRD pp.44, 22)
- magic-item /variants/*/text, scoped to elemental-gem, horn-of-valhalla, bag-of-tricks -> source-derived (SRD pp.220, 226, 210-211)
- table /columns, scoped to table:travel-pace -> source-derived (SRD p.84; whole array, no per-index scope)
- table /rows, scoped to table:food-drink-and-lodging and table:services -> source-derived (SRD pp.73-74; whole array)
- feature /description, scoped to feature:cleric:destroy-undead and feature:druid:wild-shape -> source-derived (sweep finding: classProgression trimEmbeddedTable splices out a table span)

Dead-scope gate: assertFieldProvenanceScopesLive. It runs in importer cli.ts over the written pack, NOT in buildPack, because buildPack is driven by partial fixtures in the gate tests. Deviation from the spec's wording, noted for the reviewer.

Sweep: searched importer producers for template literals, joins and concatenation feeding text/description/name/columns/rows/legend/label/sourceText, and for description-from-name fallbacks. Fixed: trimEmbeddedTable splice (above). Checked verbatim: trapChecks identicalToText (substring of description), classProgressionTables literal headers, adjudicated sourceText (inside mechanics), parseFeatures/parseEquipment reflow joins. Latent, not changed: parseActions.ts and parseFeats.ts fall back to the entry name when the body is empty. No current record hits it. Follow-up: fail closed on empty bodies.

Records: records.json byte-identical. Only field-provenance.json changed. npm run import:dnd5e-srd and verify:dnd5e-srd-pack match.

Tests: new test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/composedDisplayProvenance.test.ts (SRD witnesses, verbatim controls, no leak, dead-scope gate on pack). New test/rules/fieldProvenanceScopes.test.ts (precedence, overlap, validation, v2 loader, dead-scope cases). Existing gate and discovery tests: only classifyFieldPointer call sites changed to pass a key. No assertion weakened.

Thaw note: docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/2026-11-01-eshyra-o9bd-16-7-2-composed-display-provenance.md (covers the schema bump).

Verify: npm run verify:worktree passed its format, check, typecheck and test steps (388 files passed, 2 skipped; 7274 tests passed, 3 skipped). Test step wall 173s.

Freeze: freeze-manifest hashes NOT touched. verify:dnd5e-srd-freeze already reports hash mismatches on records.json, manifest.json, source-coverage.json, source-region-ledger.json and two audit docs, before this bead. Not touched here; re-freeze owns it.
